entities.name: Hightrunk Chamber
entities.description: The royal court and seat of power of the Elven Empire of Havenwood on Sarpadia.

entities.name: Elven Empire of Havenwood
entities.description: The elven empire on Sarpadia whose royal court was the Hightrunk Chamber.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: The place where the Elven Empire of Havenwood lay.

entities.name: Morgan
entities.description: A Thelonite Druid and advisor who held sway at the Hightrunk Chamber court.

entities.name: Loren
entities.description: A master scout who held sway at the court.

entities.name: Kolevi
entities.description: The elder druid and leader of the ruling council.

events.summary: The ruling council, headed by a king, used the Hightrunk Chamber as a meeting place; Morgan and Loren held sway there with differing goals, and Kolevi led the council.
events.quote: The ruling council, headed by a king, used the court as a meeting place.

relations.note: It was the royal court and seat of power of the empire.
relations.quote: The Hightrunk Chamber was the royal court and seat of power of the Elven Empire of Havenwood on Sarpadia

relations.note: Kolevi was the council leader and elder druid.
relations.quote: The council leader and elder druid was named Kolevi
